◉　Plot

　　This sequel to "Pandora's Box" continues director Jeffrey Lau's adaptation of the Buddhism saga "Journey
　　to the West". Stranded five centuries in the past, Joker Monkey King must battle a variety of monsters,
　　seductive women and super-powered villains to save the dying Pak Jing-Jing.
